dc_how_to_play_desc: Pick a contest, register, and trade the demo MT5 account we provide. The top traders at the end of each round share a real cash prize pool.

dc_rules_subtitle: Please read these rules carefully before joining any contest.
dc_rules_footer: Rules may differ slightly for individual contests. Always check the contest details before joining.
dc_rule_objective_desc: Grow the demo balance more than your competitors over the contest window. Highest profit % wins.
dc_rule_account_desc: A dedicated demo MT5 account with virtual balance will be opened for you automatically — you cannot trade on a personal demo account.
dc_rule_instruments_desc: Only the instruments listed in the contest details are eligible. Out-of-list trading can void your entry.
dc_rule_leverage_desc: Maximum effective leverage is set per contest. Violating the cap disqualifies your entry.
dc_rule_ranking_desc: Traders are ranked by % profit. Daily drawdown and consistency are used as tiebreakers.
dc_rule_prizes_desc: Prizes are funded by the contest sponsor and credited to your trading wallet within 24 hours of results.
dc_rule_fair_desc: Latency arbitrage, hedging across accounts, copy-trading from non-master accounts, and abusive strategies are forbidden.
dc_faq_q1: Can I use my own demo account?
dc_faq_a1: No. We issue you a dedicated contest MT5 account so rankings remain comparable across participants.
dc_faq_q2: Can I join more than one contest?
dc_faq_a2: Yes — you can join any active or upcoming contest simultaneously. Each uses its own demo account.
dc_faq_q3: What happens if I disconnect during trading?
dc_faq_a3: Your trades remain in effect. The contest uses end-of-window P&L, so temporary disconnects do not disqualify you as long as your positions are closed before the timer ends.
